title: Gym membership that renews automatically with a business-day cancellation notice
notes: Notice is ten business days, so numeric calendar days must stay null. An astral emoji precedes every span, so UTF-16 and code point offsets differ.

clauses.span: this Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms
The Club may change the monthly dues for any Renewal Term by posting the new rate at the front desk at least thirty (30) days before that Renewal Term begins.
the Member must deliver written notice to the Club at least ten (10) business days before the Renewal Date
the Member shall pay an early termination fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the monthly dues remaining in the Initial Term
A late fee of $15.00 applies to any payment that remains unpaid ten (10) days after its due date.

governing_law.span: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.
